name: guardrail
description: Seungho's Claude Code plugin marketplace — fe-rail (frontend spec→build→review→PR harness), self-improvement (evidence-gated convention repair loop), parallel-worktree (parallel subagents in isolated worktrees), and e2e-rail (change-aware Playwright E2E with a verification ledger).

plugins.name: fe-rail
plugins.description: Harness dedicated to frontend projects. Supports Next.js App Router / Vite SPA + TypeScript, Tailwind v3/v4, shadcn/ui. Automates the spec→build→review→PR cycle.

plugins.name: self-improvement
plugins.description: Conventions that fix themselves — evidence-gated convention repair loop plus a budget/archive system for bloated rule docs. Stack-agnostic (FE/BE/scripts/docs).

plugins.name: parallel-worktree
plugins.description: Run subagents in parallel across isolated git worktrees and harvest the finished ones upstream — bootstrap, dispatch, harvest, and the failure modes a green gate cannot see. Harness- and stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: e2e-rail
plugins.description: Change-aware Playwright E2E — runs only the specs a change can reach (widening to a full run whenever unsure), records every run against a code fingerprint so a stale green is never reused, and shards by measured durations. Skills drive the e2e-rail CLI installed in the repo (pnpm add -D github:sh5623/e2e-rail#v0.2.1).
